conventions: share = nominal split of the phase-2 attack events (there is NO cadence on the wiki: attack speed2 = 0, so the split is a rough reading of 'sets of attacks' -> pools -> one quadrant attack). Every row is avoidable and never counted: the counted sum is 0. Shares sum to 1.

attacks.name: Purple portal attacks (quadrant barrage)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'Ocellus will teleport to the center of the arena and create 4 quadrants surrounded by orange and purple portals. Purple portals will spawn damaging attacks, while 2 orange portals will spawn on either side that intersect in a safe zone.' Ocellus page: 'Standing at the intersection of the orange portals will avoid damage.' No damage number, no style, no cadence anywhere on the wiki. Dodged by standing on the orange intersection -> avoidable.

attacks.name: Purple void pools (floor)
attacks.note: Ocellus page: 'Eventually all of the portals will turn purple and purple voids will spawn on the floor, damaging you. Avoid these voids until an orange portal appears on the ground.' Strategies: 'After a few sets of attacks, purple damaging pools will spawn on the floor of the arena followed by an orange portal.' No number. Avoidable by not standing in them.

attacks.name: Full-quadrant attack (quadrant becomes unsafe)
attacks.note: Ocellus page: 'Step on the orange portal to avoid the full quadrant attack and jump to the next quadrant. This will repeat 3 times until the next phase.' Strategies: 'This will allow players to teleport to a new quadrant and avoid the incoming barrage of attacks as the quadrant becomes unsafe.' No number. Avoidable by taking the orange portal.

phases: Starts 'Once his shield is reduced to 0'. Sets of portal attacks -> purple pools -> orange portal -> next quadrant, 'This will repeat 3 times until the next phase.' Then: 'Ocellus will equip the sword and shatter the floor, splitting the room into four quadrants. Travelling between quadrants is possible but requires hopping on all three stepping stones.' Skip: 'There is a method to step diagonally between two tiles to skip all of the waves, though it is nearly tick-perfect.'
sanityOrOther: Expected damage taken under standard play: 0 - every phase-2 attack is positional and dodged by the orange intersection / orange portal; the wiki quantifies none of them. Half of the damage dealt to the Blade here is carried into the 5,250 phase-3 bar.
uncertainReason: No hitpoints2 on the wiki (sheet value kept), no damage numbers, no style, no cadence for any phase-2 attack.
